description.value: Petty gods keep turning up in the wastes with their own petty liturgies, and you've bothered to learn a few. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Religion checks made to identify or appease a petty god's specific dogma, rather than treating all of them as a single unknown tradition.

cinderfall.incomplete: The +1 Religion bonus needs a target trait for 'a petty god's specific dogma,' which doesn't exist anywhere in this corpus.
